summary.en: Sort weighted offers, reject cycle-closing edges and merge components with union-find.

pseudocode: sort edges by weight, preserving original edge order for ties
make one disjoint set per vertex; total = 0
for each edge (u,v,w) in sorted order
a = find(u); b = find(v), using path compression
if a == b: reject the edge because it closes a cycle
otherwise union by size; accept edge; total += w
report total and V minus accepted edges as the component count

complexity.time: O(E log E) sorting plus O(E alpha(V)) union-find
complexity.space: O(V+E) including graph and visual queue entries
